candidates.title: Runaway Festival Ball
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the festival's painted ball rolled downhill toward a flooded ditch before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they chased it directly, but the slippery bank forced them to stop; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a fallen branch could guide the ball into a shallow puddle instead; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they positioned the branch safely and recovered the ball without entering the ditch, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Frostbitten Flower
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the last festival flower was wilting in the unexpected cold before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they moved it into sunlight, but the soil remained frozen overnight; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized warm water hidden in a covered jug could loosen the icy earth gently; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they warmed the roots slowly and replanted the flower in a sheltered bed, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Misdelivered Gift Box
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a gift box arrived without its recipient's name on the label before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they carried it door to door, but no neighbor recognized the wrapping; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a tiny crest on the ribbon matched the old community theater's emblem; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they delivered the sealed gift box to the theater's waiting costume maker, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
